sentences.japanese: これで彼の霊も浮かばれるだろう。
sentences.english: With this his spirit will be consoled.

sentences.japanese: 霊はこの世のどこにもいらっしゃいます。この学園はお社の跡地に作られていますので、特にお集まりになる傾向があります。
sentences.english: Spirits are to be found all over the world. This school was built upon the site of a shrine and thus there is a particular tendency for them to gather.

sentences.japanese: 彼はひざをついて故人の霊に祈りを捧げた。
sentences.english: He got down on his knees and prayed for the souls of the deceased.

sentences.japanese: 彼はひざまずいて故人の霊に祈りをささげた。
sentences.english: He got down on his knees and prayed for the souls of the deceased.

sentences.japanese: 肉によって生まれたものは肉です。御霊によって生まれたものは霊です。
sentences.english: Flesh gives birth to flesh, Spirit gives birth to Spirit.
